summary: Fixed migration 0012 (index dropped/recreated on elevation_m, integer feet-to-metre conversion rounding halves away from zero) and 0013 (full_name without concat_ws, unavailable in SQLite 3.40.1), the label view (metres), and stratum.toml (collectors read as cp1252, taxon seed deferred, basis map completed with TS and SD). Fresh build succeeds, and a copy of the 1.6.0 database upgrades to the identical schema and rows.
